title: Noel Cabangon to stage benefit concert
summary: OPM singer-songwriter Noel Cabangon will headline a benefit concert billed as "Kanlungan Para sa Hospice" at UPLB Makiling Botanic Gardens in Los Baños, Laguna on November 12.
